patched.notes: PAT-1278: declared type 'tbz' doesn't match GitHub's actual asset extension. Sigil-Ebook/Sigil releases ship 'Sigil.app-<version>-Mac-arm64.txz' and 'Sigil.app-<version>-Mac-x86_64.txz' (confirmed via GitHub releases API against the 'latest' release, tag 2.8.1, 2026-08-13; matches engine/Installomator.sh's own sigil label, which sets archiveName to 'Mac-arm64.txz'/'Mac-x86_64.txz'). Added asset_pattern '\\.txz$' so _github_release_asset_suffix()'s type-derived '.tbz' guess is bypassed. Team ID and URL still require human review before setting allowlisted=true.
